sources.benchApp: bench/browser-app — edytor resolved from tests/packed-consumer/node_modules (the tarball above)

meta.engine: vendored @y/y@14.0.0-rc.26 (upstream 96c96e1fcb1ef6ce866d5264b3f97f7f77b11f64) + recorded local patches — P1 lib0-v14 specifier rewrite, P4 format-aware search-marker checkpoints; NOT unmodified upstream (see src/lib/crdt/vendor/yjs/UPSTREAM.md)
meta.note: ms = wall-clock milliseconds in-page; bytes = byteLength of emitted updates / bundle files; counts = deterministic work counters.

small.note_mount: goto domcontentloaded → all seeded [data-edytor-block] nodes rendered (cold mount incl. module load + init + first render)

keystroke.coldNote: first keystroke after mount (JIT-cold editor path); warm stats are all samples including it
keystroke.note: trusted CDP keypress "x": keydown→beforeinput→facade insertText→DOM mutation→rAF callback. Stages share the keystroke t0. rafMs = frame-callback scheduling, NOT paint.

delete.note: trusted Backspace: beforeinput deleteContentBackward → facade deleteText → DOM mutation → rAF.

formatHotkey.note: trusted Meta+b after a real Shift+ArrowLeft range selection: keydown → hotkey setMarkAndSelect → formatRange → DOM → rAF. No beforeinput — t0 is keydown.

facadeToDom.note: facade.insertText → DOM mutation + rAF — the model→publication→Svelte→DOM segment. Reported alongside keystroke stages, NEVER subtracted (R7).

pasteText.note: facade.insertText of a 500-char string in one op — paste-like bulk insert.

undo.note: undoManager.undo() after ONE tracked facade insert — the measured span is the undo step only; the setup insert is unmeasured (combined insert+undo per sample would conflate the two).

remoteBurst.note: 30 remote keystroke updates applied sequentially via applyUpdateStaged (the real provider path); per-apply ms + ONE batched Svelte flush observed via MO/rAF.

reconnect.note: 30 offline peer edits → one diff update → applyUpdateStaged → DOM/rAF.

serialize.note: explicit full-document export (edytor.value JSON.stringify) — NOT part of the baseline keystroke path.

small.heapNote: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize (Chromium-only, coarse — includes uncollected garbage; not a retained-heap measurement).
